profiles.style: Photorealistic fossorial marsupial anatomical & natural-history film fidelity
profiles.delivery_target: Offline high-detail render / FilmCraft handoff (ECO-WP-07B pending)

profiles.style: Real-time 3-layer PBR + 24-joint fossorial rig + InstanceState64 habitat LODs
Expressive stylized silhouette preserving broad flattened cranium, bare granular rhinarium, rounded ears, spade claws & armored rump

animal_behaviour.description: Fossorial excavation of 15-30 m burrow networks using alternating triceps/pectoralis/latissimus forelimb strokes and hind-pes soil bulldozing
Wedging thickened fibrocartilaginous pelvic_dermal_shield upward against burrow ceiling to crush intruding predators
Nocturnal grazing and territorial cubic-scat deposition on elevated flat rocks and logs

animal_interaction.description: Allogenic ecosystem engineering providing 15-30 m thermal and bushfire refugia for co-occurring SE Australian wildlife

animal_process.description: Continuous rootless tooth growth compensating for silica wear from native tussock grasses and roots
8-14 day digesta dehydration and alternating circumferential distal-colon stiffness producing 20-30 mm cubic scats

animal_relation.description: ro:0002470 grazing on Poa sieberiana, Themeda triandra, Carex appressa, and Lomandra longifolia
ro:0002303 terrestrial subterranean burrow & forest-grassland ecotone (0-1850 m)

animal_state.description: Normal fossorial/grazing state within q42:rom:* joint bounds (shoulder, elbow, wrist, hip, knee, ankle, spine, neck)

behaviour.description: InstanceState64 ontogenetic stages, rotary scratch-digging power model, waddle walk, burrow rump-block defense, and thermal/acoustic aura hooks

component.description: Layer 0 osteology (UBERON:0001434) — flattened cranium, flared zygomatic arches, hypselodont teeth, flared deltopectoral humerus crest, 24-joint rig
Layer 1 myology (UBERON:0001630) — triceps brachii, pectoralis, latissimus dorsi, masseter/temporalis, epaxial/gluteal
Layer 2 integument (UBERON:0002416) — coarse grizzled pelage, bare granular rhinarium, small rounded ears, backward marsupium
Thickened 10-15 mm fibrocartilaginous/dermal rump shield (pelvic_dermal_shield) over sacrum and ilium
Specialized distal colon biomechanics (UBERON:0001155) producing cubic scat
Plantigrade 5-digit forepaws with spade claws (UBERON:0002398) and syndactylous II-III hind feet (UBERON:0002387)

graph_partition.description: Sealed NQuin taxonomic, anatomical, ROM, InstanceState64 & Country graph (573 quins)
Sealed NQuin DCAT dataset & distribution manifest (70 quins)

locomotor_mode.description: Short-burst defensive gallop up to 11.1 m/s (~40 km/h)
Alternating forelimb scrape and hind-pes soil bulldozing inside 15-30 m tunnels

profile.description: Cartoon representation with declared film/realtime delivery

relation_family.description: ro:0002131 anatomical partonomy linking UBERON osteology, myology, integument, pelvic_dermal_shield & colon
ro:0002470 grazing & tk:custodial_country SE Australia Country provenance

rig.description: 24-joint PGA vombatid_fossorial rig + 4 two-bone IK grounded paw contacts + NLA channelbag (waddle, scratch-digging, rump-block, mastication)

sound.description: Low raspy defensive grunt/hiss (112 Hz fundamental + 340 Hz rasp harmonic, 110-420 Hz bandpass) encoded to .qac v1

source.description: Atlas of Living Australia (ALA) BIE species profile

surface.description: Chiang hair BSDF (roughness 0.48, IOR 1.55) + 256x256 procedural grizzled guard-hair PBR maps (colour, normal, orm) + 3-tone countershaded pelage

trait.description: Head-body 0.85-1.15 m, shoulder height 0.35-0.45 m, adult mass 22.0-38.0 kg
Hypometabolic fossorial marsupial BMR 32.0 W (Tb 34.8 C)
Distal colon differential stiffness producing 20-30 mm cubic scats

variant.description: InstanceState64 pelage_grizzle_melanin across sandy-brown to charcoal-grey pelage
InstanceState64 mange_stress_01 sarcoptic mange vulnerability parameter
